byte_exact_rationale: These receipts are pinned by SHA256 in data/manifests/sources.yaml and validate_new_source refuses to run when a byte differs. They are published unmodified so a reader can verify the frozen data-integration chain; the host paths inside them are historical provenance records, not configuration.

exempt_files.tools/build_publication_bundle.py: defines the prefix-rewriting rules it applies
exempt_files.tools/check_portability.py: defines the host-path pattern it searches for
exempt_files.tools/normalize_fixture_host_paths_20261: counts occurrences of the username pattern it removes
exempt_files.tools/repin_proof_backend_portability_20: defines the host-path pattern it verifies against

exemption_rationale: only the tools that define or apply these patterns, and the gitignored host-location config, may name them; the derived manifest and index redact the identifier
note: this file is written after the scan and contains only counts and repository-relative paths
